content:
The image displays a soybean leaf with numerous small, angular spots. The spots are reddish-brown and appear somewhat speckled across the leaf surface. There are also some larger, irregular yellowed areas where the spots are more concentrated. The description for Brown Spot mentions "Angular, red to brown spots appear on leaves that vary from tiny specks to quarter-inch diameter," and "Initial symptoms are small dark brown spots...that appear first on lower leaves and progress upward." This aligns well with the visual evidence. Bacterial Blight is a possibility, but its lesions are described with "yellowish-green halos," which are not prominent here. Septoria Brown Spot is mentioned as being similar to Bacterial Blight. Given the angular, reddish-brown specks, Brown Spot is the most likely diagnosis.
